text:
Samir (CS): P1 from AcmeHealth — after SSO provisioning they can only run embeddings/rerank. /v1/generate returns 403 or an empty stream. Customer onboarding blocked. Rep steps and claim dump below. req_id: req_20260302_abc123 :eyes:
Samir (CS): Claim payload (redacted):
```
{"sub":"acme|123","scopes":"embeddings rerank"}  # note: scopes appears as a single string with a non-breaking-space between tokens
```
Samir (CS): Curl they ran: `curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{\"prompt\":\"hello\"}'` -> 403 response: `{"error":"insufficient_scope","detail":"missing permission: generate"}`
Marta P: Do we have the provision job id / which provisioner version did they use? Also need the exact token (partial) or request-ids to pull logs.
Samir (CS): Prov job id: prov-7788, provisioner v2.0.1 (SCIM CSV bulk). Token last4: ****abcd. Sent request-ids + log link to #secure-attachments.
Jordan (oncall): I pulled ingress logs for req_20260302_abc123 — the JWT incoming claim `scopes` is a single string. Our auth layer expects an array or a space-delimited string. Because the CSV used NBSP (U+00A0) we end up with `scopes` == "embeddings rerank" which our split-on-space missed, leaving no "generate" token. Quick workaround: create a new API key from the tenant console and explicitly select the "Generate / inference" checkbox. That will bypass provisioning. :+1:
Samir (CS): Customer asked for a non-manual path — they run bulk SCIM import at scale. They want backfill.
Provisioner Bot: [prov-7788] warn: parsed_scopes: ["embeddings rerank"] -> normalized_scopes: "embeddings,rerank" (sanitizer collapsed but did not normalize unicode).
Eng:auth: looking at the logs now. Root cause: CSV normalizer didn't normalize unicode whitespace before splitting. NBSP remained glued so our whitespace-split lost it. Also our validator rejects tokens that contain non-ascii or control chars, so the token containing NBSP was dropped entirely when we validated allowed scope names — hence generate was missing. PR open: https://github.com/redwood-inference/provisioner/pull/1234 (unicode normalize + validation fix). ETA hotfix to staging in ~45m, prod in ~3h if tests pass.
Marta P: Can we get a list of affected tenants/jobs so CS can contact them?
Eng:auth: yes — can query prov jobs for entries where raw_scopes LIKE '% %'. Example query for infra: `SELECT job_id, tenant_id FROM provision_jobs WHERE raw_scopes LIKE '% %';` We'll run it and share list.
Jordan (oncall): Short-term mitigation for AcmeHealth: rotate key via console (create key -> tick "Generate (inference)"), or run this admin CLI: `redwood admin keys create --tenant acme --scopes "generate,embeddings,rerank"` then update their app. I can do that if CS needs.
Samir (CS): Please do the admin create and mark as ETA-critical. Customer is in onboarding and blocked. I'll file the ticket and ping them. :pray:
Eng:auth: Also adding a migration job to backfill keys for affected tenants who used the broken provisioner version. We will require consent for rotating keys; CS, please call out which tenants we can auto-rotate.
Samir (CS): Will compile list. Thanks all. I'll update AcmeHealth with the rotation workaround and an ETA for the permanent fix. :white_check_mark:
